title_zh: 江苏“人工智能+”培训全面开花 每年计划培训超20万人次
title_en: Jiangsu Launches Comprehensive "AI+" Training, Aiming Over 200,000 Trainees Annually
summary_zh: 江苏省全面开展“人工智能+”技术技能专项培训行动，计划每年培训超20万人次，以补齐群众AI技能短板、打通就业堵点。
summary_en: Jiangsu has launched a comprehensive "AI+" technical skills training initiative, aiming to train over 200,000 people annually to address AI skill gaps and employment bottlenecks.
